name: LibreSpeed
description: A self-hosted speed test: download, upload, ping and jitter measured against this server from the browser, with results kept in a local SQLite database.

access.note: The speed test has no accounts: anyone who reaches the address can run it against this server, which costs bandwidth, so keep the domain behind the dashboard's password protection if strangers should not. The statistics page at /results/stats.php is the one protected part — it asks for the generated PASSWORD, which you reveal from the Variables tab.

inputs.name: domain
inputs.label: Public domain
inputs.description: Optional; the address other people open; nothing else here changes when it does.

secrets.name: stats-password
secrets.label: Statistics page password
secrets.description: Asked for by /results/stats.php, the page listing every test that was run.

ports.name: http
ports.purpose: The test page and its measurement endpoints

volumes.name: database
volumes.purpose: The SQLite database of test results

update.notes: The results database is a plain SQLite file the image opens as it is; there is nothing to migrate.
